systems.owner: Ministry of Health (the plan's author; the abbreviations list a Direction de la planification, de la coopération et de l'information sanitaire, DPCIS)

note: The stored body is the first 50,000 characters of the plan and stops in chapter 2, before section 3.3.2 (Système d'information sanitaire) and sub-programme 4.6 (component 4.6.1 SNIS, component 4.6.3 Santé digitale), which appear only as table-of-contents lines; the SNIS is therefore named with no description of what it does, and no fact is taken. The stored text does give the public facility counts usable as denominators: 746 health posts and 118 health centres in the health pyramid, or 794 health posts and 115 health centres in the 2018 SARA census.
